definitions.explanation: People related by blood or marriage.

examples.japanese: {親類|しんるい}が{集|あつ}まって{食事|しょくじ}をした。
examples.english: The relatives gathered for a meal.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}い{親類|しんるい}に{会|あ}った。
{親類|しんるい}の{結婚式|けっこんしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
・{親戚|しんせき} - relatives (same meaning, more common)
・{親類|しんるい} - relatives (slightly more formal)
・{親族|しんぞく} - kinfolk (legal/formal term)
・{身内|みうち} - family members, close relatives

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{遠|とお}い{親類|しんるい} (distant relative)
・{近|ちか}い{親類|しんるい} (close relative)
・{親類|しんるい}{縁者|えんじゃ} (relatives and connections)

NOTE: {親戚|しんせき} is more commonly used in modern Japanese, but {親類|しんるい} is interchangeable.

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
